pages.title: SITE: ECHO-7
pages.text: $(bold)ORSA LAUNCH MANIFEST$()$(br)Prepared by: ORSA Evacuation Logistics$(br2)Launch window sealed at 03:14.$(br)Heat bloom remains unsafe.$(br2)Evacuee count cleared: $(6)2,184$()$(br)Holdovers recorded: $(c)713$()$(br2)Names withheld under ORSA emergency protocol.

pages.title: Ground Directive
pages.text: "If the pit is still warm, build here. The cold never fully took the stone.$(br2)The walls won't save you.$(br)The weather won't stop.$(br)But the ground remembers fire."$(br2)This was not written for the evacuation list. It was written for whoever came after.

pages.title: Handwritten Addendum
pages.text: $(italic)We left too many behind.$()$(br2)$(italic)If anyone finds this, the site still works better than the surface around it. Use the heat. Make it count.$()$(br2)- K
